section: §6/§7/§10 listed cable assembly + geometric length reconciliation
purpose: The micro AC branch trunk is a LISTED cable assembly (never generic THWN); its length is geometry-derived per branch (never the plane-width heuristic). Drops (1/micro) are the reconciling invariant across PV-1B geometry, PV-4B, SCHED and the BOM; procurement footage = Σ drops×pitch×waste; designed-installed = Σ geometric path.

listedCableAssembly.insulationListing: THHN/THWN-2 conductors; UL 9703 (cable assemblies) / UL 3003 (raw cable); permitted in free air per NEC 690.31(C)
listedCableAssembly.sourceDocument: Enphase IQ Cable accessories Data Sheet DSH-00247-1.0 (2024-07-03)
